Class MarlinWeightPacker

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.quant.MarlinWeightPacker
public final class MarlinWeightPacker extends Object
Packs HuggingFace GPTQ / AWQ INT4 tensors into Marlin layout for MarlinLinear. Invoked only when WeightGemmBackend.MARLIN is selected (Ampere/Ada).

Default HF load path uses packAwqDirect(Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, int, Device, Integer) / packGptqDirect(Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, int, Device, Integer) (dequant → optional RoPE permute → Marlin requant). packFromFp16(Tensor, int, Device) remains for tests and dense requant.

    • packAwq

      public static MarlinWeightPacker.Packed packAwq(Tensor qweight, Tensor scales, Tensor qzeros, int groupSize, Device device)
      Packs AutoAWQ GEMM tensors into Marlin layout.

      Dequantizes with AWQ zeros (exact), then requants into Marlin's symmetric int4 (zp=8). Folding zeros into int4 with clamp is unsafe when |q - z| > 7.

      Parameters:
      qweight - AWQ packed weights.
      scales - group scales.
      qzeros - packed zeros, or null.
      groupSize - quantization group size.
      device - destination device.
      Returns:
      Marlin-packed tensors.

    • packGptqDirect

      public static MarlinWeightPacker.Packed packGptqDirect(Tensor qweight, Tensor scales, Tensor qzeros, Tensor gIdx, int groupSize, Device device, Integer ropeHeads)
      Direct GPTQ→Marlin pack. Act-order (g_idx not sequential) fails fast.

      Dequantizes (with zeros when present), optionally applies HF→Meta RoPE rearrange, then requants into Marlin symmetric int4.

      Parameters:
      qweight - GPTQ packed weights.
      scales - group scales.
      qzeros - packed zeros, or null.
      gIdx - GPTQ g_idx, or null.
      groupSize - quantization group size.
      device - destination device.
      ropeHeads - if non-null, permute out-features for Meta-style RoPE.
      Returns:
      Marlin-packed tensors.
